title: Cagrilintide dosage with tirzepatide: what has and has not been tested
excerpt: No human trial has given cagrilintide with tirzepatide, so no combined dose exists. Tirzepatide has only been CagriSema's comparator, and the only shared study was in rats [[1]][[3]].
body:
Cagrilintide and tirzepatide have never been given together in a human trial, so there is no cagrilintide dosage with tirzepatide: no combined chart, no blended schedule, and no safety data for the pair. In the cagrilintide programme, tirzepatide appears only as the drug that CagriSema (cagrilintide plus semaglutide) was compared against [[1]][[2]]. The only study that put cagrilintide and tirzepatide into the same subjects was in rats [[3]]. What follows reports each drug's own doses separately, the head-to-head results, and why the pairing is a separate, unanswered question.

This page belongs to cagrilintide dosage, which charts every dose the cagrilintide trials used. The parallel question for the triple agonist is on cagrilintide with retatrutide; the approved drug's record is tirzepatide, and the combination that was tested is CagriSema.

seo.title: Cagrilintide With Tirzepatide: Dosage, Trials and Evidence
seo.description: No trial has tested cagrilintide with tirzepatide. Each drug's own doses, the CagriSema vs tirzepatide head-to-head results, and why blends are unstudied.

sections.heading: Has cagrilintide been tested with tirzepatide?
sections.lede: In people, no. In rats, once, as a comparator. With a different amylin drug, yes.
sections.html:
Evidence that exists for cagrilintide and tirzepatide, by kind
EvidenceWhat was givenWhat it shows
Human trials of cagrilintide plus tirzepatideNone published or announcedNo dose, efficacy or safety data for the pair
Head-to-head phase 3 trials [[1]][[2]]CagriSema in one group, tirzepatide in anotherWhich treatment did better; nothing about giving both
Rat study, Nature Metabolism 2026 [[3]]Daily co-administration in obese male rats; cagrilintide with retatrutide, against comparator combinations incorporating semaglutide or tirzepatideCagrilintide plus retatrutide reduced weight and food intake more than the comparators
Eloralintide plus tirzepatide (EloraTZP) [[4]]A different amylin drug with tirzepatide, phase 2, 48 weeksUp to 23.3% weight loss vs 14.8% on tirzepatide 15 mg alone, with more discontinuations

Pages that describe a "cagrilintide and tirzepatide combination trial" are describing something that does not exist in the published or announced record. The rat study is the closest direct evidence, and it is weak for this question: the animals were dosed daily, not weekly, the doses were chosen for rats, and the study's subject was retatrutide [[3]].

The more informative evidence is indirect. Lilly paired its own amylin drug, eloralintide, with tirzepatide and ran a dedicated phase 2 trial in 367 adults with type 2 diabetes [[4]]. That a manufacturer needed its own dose-finding trial for the pair, and then planned a co-formulation with an adjusted escalation for phase 3, shows how much is unknown before such a combination is tested. Eloralintide is covered on eloralintide and the wider class on amylin analogs.

sections.heading: Cagrilintide and tirzepatide doses, each drug on its own
sections.lede: Two separate tables, because the doses come from separate evidence. They are not a combined schedule.
sections.html:
Tirzepatide: doses in the US label and in the SURMOUNT-1 trial
SourceDoseScheduleResult
Zepbound label [[5]]2.5 mg weekly to start, not a maintenance dose; then 5 mgIncrease in 2.5 mg steps after at least 4 weeks on the current doseMaintenance 5, 10 or 15 mg weekly; maximum 15 mg
SURMOUNT-1 trial [[6]]5, 10 or 15 mg weekly72 weeks, including a 20-week dose escalationWeight -15.0%, -19.5% and -20.9% vs -3.1% placebo
Cagrilintide: doses given in trials (no label exists)
TrialDoseScheduleResult
Phase 2 dose-finding [[7]]0.3 to 4.5 mg weekly, alone26 weeks, escalation up to 6 weeksWeight -6.0% to -10.8% vs -3.0% placebo
REDEFINE 1, cagrilintide-only arm [[8]]2.4 mg weekly, alone68 weeks, flexible dosingWeight -11.8% vs -2.3% placebo
CagriSema phase 3 [[9]][[2]]2.4 mg, 1.7 mg or 1.0 mg weekly, with the same dose of semaglutide68 weeksWeight -20.4% at 2.4/2.4 mg (treatment-policy)

Tirzepatide is approved: the FDA cleared it for chronic weight management as Zepbound on 8 November 2023 [[10]], and its label sets the schedule above [[5]]. Cagrilintide is not approved, so its figures are trial arms. Placing the two tables side by side does not produce a dose for the pair. Every cagrilintide dose in these trials was tested either alone or with semaglutide, never on top of tirzepatide's GIP and GLP-1 activity [[6]].

sections.heading: Why two appetite-suppressing drugs together are a separate question
sections.html:
Combining two drugs that both reduce appetite and slow the stomach is not the same as adding their results. The best measurement of that comes from CagriSema itself. In REDEFINE 1, cagrilintide alone produced 11.8% weight loss and semaglutide alone 16.1%; together they produced 22.7%, not 27.9% [[8]]. The overlap is real, and it is specific to each pair.

Side effects are where combinations cost most. In REDEFINE 1, gastrointestinal adverse events affected 79.6% of people on cagrilintide plus semaglutide, against 39.9% on placebo [[9]]. In the eloralintide plus tirzepatide trial, discontinuations because of adverse events ranged from 10.8% to 27.0% across the combination groups, against 2.9% on tirzepatide alone [[4]]. Whether cagrilintide on top of tirzepatide would behave like either pair is unknown, because nobody has measured it.

Three further gaps follow from the absence of a trial: no one knows which dose ratio works, how the two should be escalated together, or what happens to tolerability at tirzepatide's top dose. Those are exactly the questions the CagriSema and EloraTZP programmes spent years answering for their own pairs [[11]][[4]].

sections.heading: Cagrilintide vs tirzepatide: what the head-to-head trials measured
sections.lede: Both direct comparisons tested CagriSema, not cagrilintide alone.
sections.html:
Head-to-head trials of CagriSema against tirzepatide (topline company results)
TrialWhoDoses comparedLengthResult
REDEFINE 4 [[1]]809 adults with obesity, open-labelCagriSema 2.4/2.4 mg vs tirzepatide 15 mg84 weeks-23.0% vs -25.5% (efficacy estimand); -20.2% vs -23.6% (treatment-regimen); non-inferiority not shown
REIMAGINE 5 [[2]]Adults with type 2 diabetes on metformin, an SGLT2 inhibitor or bothCagriSema 1.0/1.0 mg vs tirzepatide 5 mg60 weeksWeight -12.4% vs -9.1% (superior); HbA1c -1.71 vs -1.67 points (non-inferior)

Read together, the two trials say that CagriSema at its full dose did not match tirzepatide at its full dose, and that at lower doses CagriSema 1.0/1.0 mg lost more weight than tirzepatide 5 mg. Tirzepatide's label allows escalation beyond 5 mg [[5]], so the second result speaks mainly to people who stay on lower doses.

Cagrilintide alone against tirzepatide alone has never been tested. Across separate trials, cagrilintide 2.4 mg produced 11.8% over 68 weeks [[8]] and tirzepatide 15 mg produced 20.9% over 72 weeks [[6]], but those trials differ in population and design. A 2026 network meta-analysis of 25 trials placed tirzepatide 15 mg at -17.97% and CagriSema at -17.84% against placebo [[12]].

The mechanisms differ. Tirzepatide activates GIP and GLP-1 receptors [[6]]; cagrilintide activates amylin and calcitonin receptors [[13]]. That difference is the reason people ask about pairing them, and also the reason a trial would be needed to know what the pair does.

sections.heading: Cagrilintide and tirzepatide blends
sections.html:
A "cagri tirz blend" or "cagrilintide and tirzepatide blend" is a mixture sold outside any approved product or trial. No manufacturer makes one, no regulator has reviewed one, and no study has measured what such a vial contains or how the two peptides behave mixed together. Cagrilintide is not approved in any form [[14]], so any cagrilintide in a blend is research-chemical material of unverified identity.

The trials that did combine an amylin drug with an incretin drug used the manufacturer's own fixed products: a dual-chamber pen for CagriSema [[15]], and a planned co-formulation for EloraTZP [[4]]. Neither result transfers to a blend. For vial arithmetic on cagrilintide alone, the cagrilintide calculator shows the formula; it does not supply a dose for a mixture.

faq.question: Can you take cagrilintide and tirzepatide together?
faq.answer: That pairing has never been tested in people, so there is no evidence on dose, benefit or safety. Tirzepatide has only been studied as a comparator to CagriSema [[1]], and the only study giving both drugs to the same subjects was in rats [[3]].

faq.question: Is there a cagrilintide and tirzepatide dosage chart?
faq.answer: No evidence-based one exists. Tirzepatide's label sets its own schedule, starting at 2.5 mg weekly and rising in 2.5 mg steps to 5, 10 or 15 mg [[5]]; cagrilintide trials used 0.3 to 4.5 mg weekly alone or with semaglutide [[7]]. Neither was tested on top of the other.

faq.question: Is cagrilintide better than tirzepatide?
faq.answer: Cagrilintide alone has not been compared with tirzepatide. CagriSema (cagrilintide plus semaglutide) lost 23.0% against 25.5% for tirzepatide 15 mg over 84 weeks and did not show non-inferiority [[1]]; at lower doses, CagriSema 1.0/1.0 mg lost 12.4% against 9.1% for tirzepatide 5 mg [[2]].

faq.question: Has any amylin drug been tested with tirzepatide?
faq.answer: Yes, eloralintide. Lilly's phase 2 trial in adults with type 2 diabetes reported up to 23.3% weight loss at 48 weeks with eloralintide plus tirzepatide, against 14.8% on tirzepatide 15 mg alone, with more discontinuations from side effects [[4]]. Those results do not apply to cagrilintide.

changelog.change: Written: what exists for cagrilintide with tirzepatide (no human trial; rat comparator study; EloraTZP as the nearest amylin-plus-tirzepatide evidence), each drug's doses in separate tables, why combinations are unstudied, REDEFINE 4 and REIMAGINE 5 head-to-head results, and the blend boundary.
